subject.title: fix(sms): ack rate-limited Twilio callbacks instead of dropping them [AI]

question: Should a signature-valid SMS callback count as successfully handled before OpenClaw has admitted it for dispatch or durable processing?
rationale: The patch intentionally trades Twilio failure/retry signaling for webhook health while still losing the message, so code review cannot choose the delivery guarantee without SMS owner intent.

options.title: Require admission before success
options.body: Return 200 only after dispatch admission or durable queueing, preserving an error response when OpenClaw cannot accept the callback.

options.title: Retain 429 with retry guidance
options.body: Keep the current failure response and document Twilio `rp=4xx` retries and fallback URLs for operators who need recovery.

options.title: Authorize ack-and-drop semantics
options.body: Explicitly accept that quota overflow is permanent message loss and document HTTP 200 as receipt-only rather than processing success.

recommendation.title: Require admission before success
recommendation.body: Return 200 only after dispatch admission or durable queueing, preserving an error response when OpenClaw cannot accept the callback.

likelyOwner.reason: This person introduced the current callback-quota boundary and is the strongest available technical routing candidate for the response-contract decision.
